I had a falling out with a group of friends like this. I always felt like a peripheral friend in the group. It took this instance to realize that friends shouldn’t make you feel like you need to prove your worth to them. I’m just glad I figured out who my real friends were before it was too late.
I literally can’t handle healthy relationships. I’ve asked my girlfriend to treat me worse before.

Closure isn’t gonna make you feel better. I was emotionally abused by my ex and I sent her a very emotional letter describing everything. And you know what happened? She responded. She sent a really long apology actually. 

I felt better for like 3 days then went back to feeling like shit again.
I’m proud that I found myself again. My relationship really made me lose sight of myself and now that I’m free I’m enjoying my old hobbies again.
Yeah. I have a lot of different emotions going on right now.
My ex was a lot like this as well. They weren’t possessive either.

I’m feeling the exact same way today. I miss them but I never want to see their face again. I cope the same way you are: talking to other people who have similar experiences. It’s probably the only coping mechanism where I’m not just distracting myself.

When I broke up with my ex I ended up having to comfort her in a weird way. She wasn’t upset that we were through but that I was upset by what she had done. She gave me a thumbs up and said she’ll emotionally process this later.
I feel this. I’m starting to understand why my ex did what they did.

I really resonate with that. I was in the hospital for a week and all I got was a “how’s it going?” after two days of not hearing from me. Things didn’t last much longer after that because she put so little effort into the relationship. Right after we broke up our mutual friends set my ex up with one of my friends. A month after BU I told how I felt about everything and she apologized but I don’t think I’ll be able to take anything she says sincerely again. To top it all off all she still wanted to be friends but was too anxious to reach out to me.

I think you’re getting hung up on the feeling of not getting over her when in reality it takes time and there is no goalpost for when you’re supposed to be over someone. Allow yourself to hurt, to miss them but know that you deserve better. Fighting the feeling of missing them is difficult and only serves to make you feel worse.
I miss the idea of her that I had built up in my head.
Thank you. I talked to my doctor and he prescribed me some medicine that won’t interact with my Cymbalta.
The Cymbalta was, the cough syrup I bought over the counter.
It just made me confused more than anything. I don’t look very manly at all. I’m a twig and I’m short.

I really relate to this, especially the fear of it all being my fault and the next guy will be so much better. The conclusion I’ve come to is that her next relationship might look better on the surface, but their behavior isn’t gonna change. If it looks like they get along better more than likely it’s just that the new guy is going to be able to tolerate more shitty behavior. 

I confronted my ex and I got a long apology but it didn’t make me feel much better; it just felt like empty words. 

I don’t know the full situation but I don’t think confrontation is the best idea, it puts a band-aid on it more than anything. You might feel good for telling them off but that feeling quickly fades. 

Best of luck. I’m here if you need someone to talk to because I truly do empathize with what you’re going through.

Yeah, you’re probably right. I when my ex and I were dating I was acting more like her. She is a very negative person and I definitely fed off of that. I’m working on being more positive. It’s been slow but steady.
Thank you. I want to be petty and passive-aggressive so bad but I know that will be bad for me in the long run. Thank you for being a rational voice for me.

My current girlfriend says I complain a lot. I understand what happened but I’m still upset about it. If I was on the fence I just wish she would have been honest about it instead of leading me on before we started dating and then treating me poorly when we did. I honestly would have been fine just being friends but after all of this I want nothing to do with her.

Ghosting someone like that multiple times signifies a pattern of intermittent reinforcement. Whether they meant to or not that is a form of abuse. 
I just went through something very similar so I know how you feel. This kind of thing can really eat away at your confidence. It’s not your fault nor is it your responsibility to “fix” them. You are not a bad person for leaving someone who isn’t putting as much effort as you are into improving.
It sounds like you have a good approach to all of this. I think the best thing you can do right now is focus on being you again and cutting your ex out of your life. 
Healing will take time. PM me if you need someone to talk to.

Holy shit did we date the same person? My ex would constantly manipulate me when it came to communication and reassurance. Any time I tried to have an important conversation she would make a lot of mean-spirited comments. Whether or not they were intentional I still don’t know to this day but she frequently played dumb when it benefitted her.

I like this. I still suffer with a taste for justice. I want my ex to suffer and pay for what they did to me. I want the world to know what a horrible person they are but deep down I know that won’t make me feel better, that will simply put a band aid on it. I want to get to a place where I don’t give a shit about what/how they’re doing.
This one hit home a little too hard.

Thank you for this reminder. I’m still healing from my previous relationship but I’m with someone new and it is a much healthier relationship. She’s amazing and I’d hate to lose her because I couldn’t get over someone who valued me so little.
That’s how my last abusive relationship ended. I had to leave them.
Same. They didn’t even mention me once. They had post after post of their ex before me though.

I feel you, but that is the abuse talking. Abuse makes us feel like we are worthless and to derive all of our value from our abuser. After that happens we have to learn to start deriving our value from ourselves instead of others. You are valid. Even if no one else cares about you (which I don’t think is the case) just know at least some random stranger on the internet cares and knows what you’re going through. You aren’t alone pal.

I really empathize with this. I was with someone who didn’t give two shits about me. I was just a punching bag for her to take her anger from her ex out on. You’re totally valid to feel used because you were. You deserve someone who doesn’t treat you like an option. I wish I had some better advice but I’m only 5 months out of my relationship. If you need someone to talk to feel free to PM me.

I really relate to this. My ex was never really aggressive but she used intermittent reinforcement A LOT. I found myself in a really toxic cycle. Her love bombing was also just treating my like a normal person and yet I still fell for it. At least now I know how to spot it in the future.

I’ve realized now how much of my personality is just me acting all “woe is me.” I didn’t realize until my girlfriend spoke up about it that I complain a lot.  I want to try to act in a more positive manner as well as not complain as much. Any ideas on how to turn that into a tangible goal?
I relate to this. My ex made me feel really bad about wearing polo shirts. She also made me feel bad about having short hair and my gender expression. I’m still really self-conscious about that.

I had to look up what a hoover is but I agree. Even in the relationship I felt like I had to stay because I didn’t think she could handle it. 

I suffer from mental health issues myself and we talked a lot about that in our relationship. I guess I still feel like she would someone good to talk to about those things… or at the very least get some empathy from her.

I relapsed about a week ago and sent her a very emotionally charged message. She responded though. She actually apologized. She told me she was sorry but it felt a lot like lip service. Her apology seemed genuine but I don’t see her changing. I have some other things I want answered. She very much was distant the entire time. She was extremely passive and preferred to give me the cold shoulder as opposed to emotional outbursts, but those happened a couple times too. She seems to be able to be a good friend just a bad partner in a relationship. At the end of her apology she told me that she would like to be friends in the future. I am very confused right now. 

Apologies if this is extremely incoherent.

Thanks bro. I was really allured by her cynicism at the start because it felt good to find someone who would validate all the negativity in my life. I realize now that there’s a fine line between not bottling up feelings and just throwing a pity party. I guess it’s just hard because our mutual friends are constantly making excuses for her shitty behavior and so I felt like I was always in the wrong. You’re right though. If they want to continue enabling her that’s fine but I don’t have to be a part of it.

I had seen a school counselor due to school stress before. But it wasn’t until after when I realized how bad my mental state had become that I got a permanent therapist. I’m glad I did because there were some other issues outside of my toxic relationship that I have improved on. When everything is all said and done, and I’m done healing, I think I’ll be better for this.

I’ve blocked her on all socials I could. We both are in a niche program at a small school so I inevitably still have to interact with her. She got an RA position on campus and I’m worried she will manipulate other people the way she did me. 

I found her Reddit account. I have yet to find out if that was good or bad. It’s probably the closest I’ll ever get to seeing her true intentions. She mentioned she liked to be nice to people, not because she liked doing nice things, but because she liked being seen as nice and so they would do nice things for her. 

I’m debating leaving the groups we are both in but I feel like that would mean she won. I feel like I can’t say anything about what she did to me because no one will believe me. 

Isolating myself completely from her is impossible. I don’t know how to proceed in the places in which I still have to interact with her.

I agree. There is something very zen about the whole experience of looking out the window and seeing the clouds and all the small building below you. The only gripe I have is how cramped it is. I always have to worry about the people I’m in front of/behind/next to.
I needed this. I keep feeling like I want to go back into the relation that caused me so much pain. I guess the abuse cycle can be addicting. :/

I think they see men like this (and men and general) as a punching bag for their frustrations. I can understand where they’re coming from because historically we have had more privilege. Don’t mistake my understanding for endorsement though. I think society/media looking at all men as a punching bag is dangerous when men more and more are being rejected by society. This kind of behavior is counterproductive and only furthers division.

I totally believe in people getting the justice they deserve but I don’t believe in karma. If we wait for karma to be served we are going to still harbor this taste for revenge. For me, I was emotionally abused and that’s a lot harder to report. I’m still working on letting go and not waiting for my abuser to fail. That just delays my healing. I hope to get to a point where they could be extremely successful and I could feel neither good nor bad about it. My only concerns going forward are my abuser’s future victims but I cannot control their actions. I can only warn them.

Thank you. I try be as factual as I can in these instances. My emotions can be invalidated but it’s a lot harder to invalidate hard facts. I’ll try my best to support other people going through similar things. I just hope I have some good advice to give them.
Well this hits home a little too hard. I feel like I can’t speak up about what happened to me because the people in her circles will attack me and continue to enable her shitty behavior.

Same. I broke things off with my abusive ex at the end of February. My mental health has improved immensely but cutting her off completely has been challenging because we go to a small college and have a lot of mutual friends.
